text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several months have passed since becoming
a temporary assistant until Haiseiko's solo concert—

text_block_list.name: Manager A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer!
We've got a bit of a problem! Could you take care of the costume!?
Please bring it to Haiseiko!

text_block_list.name: Manager B
text_block_list.text:
Also, it doesn't have to be fancy,
but could you edit a short video
for UmaTok!?

text_block_list.name: Manager B
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh, what is going on?! My schedule is packed down to the minute...! But I don't even have time to complain~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko was far busier than imagined.
Even with three managers handling her, they were still shorthanded.
choice_data_list: (But, the one who'll have it toughest is of course—)

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
The outfit, right?
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wearing a kimono might be the first time since the New Year's special!
Maybe I should learn how to dress myself in one soon?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I'm sorry!
We're in the middle of an interview!!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Haiseiko-san...
Rumor has it your three measurements haven't
changed at all since your racing days..."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes!
My weight's been staying totally the same too♪

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I-Isn't that... really hard to maintain?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ Just a little bit.
But I want to remain a "high success"!

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko-saaan!
There was something I missed telling you—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Just wait a teeny bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst her hectic days, Haiseiko still makes
time to come to Tracen Academy.
It must be unquestionably exhausting, but...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
That juice over there is from me!
Please share it with the other managers♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need a nap?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
This is live concert footage from a popular unit right now!
I thought it might be good reference for our concerts...
These girls are just so super cute♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how busy she was, she never forgot to smile...
Not once in these past few months did I see her show any sign of fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Manager A
text_block_list.text:
...She's amazing, isn't she?
As expected of the original 'Little Monster.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“‘Monster-chan’—that was
Haiseiko's nickname back in her racing days.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Invading the Central circuit undefeated from the regionals,
that cute yet unstoppable "Monster-chan"
had the entire nation swept up in racing fever...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gracing the covers of manga magazines, appearing in movies...
She became a social phenomenon and ignited a racing boom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And she is...
even now, truly a "monster."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: One... two... three...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Is it time already?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you very much
for letting us use the studio!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I wasn't able to practice much this week... so being able to borrow the space in between really helped~.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
The concert is coming up soon too!
I've gotta give it my all♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Um, up next is...
the All-Night Radio show!
choice_data_list: ...Shall we take a break before that?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true!
After all, you did accompany me all the way here...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
You can head out for today, it's fine!
I can get to the studio by myself!
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I mean— you haven't rested at all, have you?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you for your concern!
But I'm totally fine♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Alright! Well then, shall we get going?!
choice_data_list: Why do you push yourself... so hard?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: You ask why, but...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I'm...
"Haiseiko," after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And when the day of the live performance finally arrived—
I understood the meaning behind her words.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
It's all~ for you~♪
To deliver~ my love to you~♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Dreams never come to an end~♪
I've waited so long for this day to come~♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyooone!
And hello, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: HA-I-SE-I-KOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so muuuuch!
From the front row all the way to the back, I can see every one of you!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep the hype going!
And from here on out... forever and ever...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Even if I remain your Haiseiko—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
I love you all!!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please listen to our next song!
"Monster-chan"♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My body trembles at the earth-shattering roar of the crowd.
Over 100,000 spectators are in a frenzy—
over a single Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The passion and emotion directed at Haiseiko...
were no different from back when she was running in races.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Haiseiko-san is just amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Haa, that was such a wonderful concert...!
My heart is so full...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the bond between Haiseiko-san
and the fans was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Oguri-senpai, you too!
That was so moving, wasn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Incredible.
choice_data_list: By the way, Oguri, what brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and Hokko Tarumae make sense since
they both aspire to be idols, but... it's hard
to imagine Oguri Cap having that same image.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I got a ticket.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There were food trucks out there, right?
While I was having a snack over there……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A passerby gave me a ticket.
Apparently, they were in a bind because their companion couldn't make it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, and these were super premium tickets too!
We got so lucky☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Haiseiko is truly incredible.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko really...
loves everyone, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text: —Uuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then, the Haiseiko fan behind me suddenly burst into tears.
choice_data_list: Ah, um... is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text: F-Forgive me. That kid over there said something so nice, I couldn't help it...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
Haiseiko is truly incredible...――

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
—You know, she tried her hardest to stay as
the "incredible" Haiseiko her fans wished for.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
If we're just talking results, she lost the Derby despite being the overwhelming favorite...
and it's not like she won every single time, either.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that girl...
never gave up."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Back then, the business I had started was going downhill...
and the whole country just felt kind of gloomy."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, I guess I was projecting myself onto her.
I just wanted to go back to when I was at my best—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
"‘Don't give up, hang in there, Haiseiko...
You're a monster, aren't you?’—they said."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text: And yet, she kept trying her best to live up to such selfish desires.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
“For the sake of everyone hoping for ‘Monster-chan,’
she kept fighting to win...”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: For everyone's... sake...—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
The moment I felt her true feelings the most
was during her retirement ceremony concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Falco went too!
It was so deeply moving...~!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, please don't forget!
Your voices, your everything,
was my power...――"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Haiseiko was truly blessed!
And will continue to be blessed, forever and always!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text: —It suddenly... hit me.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I decided that I would keep cheering on
Haiseiko forever and always."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text:
They said as long as she keeps being Haiseiko,
they'll remain her fan until the day they die—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Haiseiko always stayed true to herself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So……
That's why you have a never-ending stream of fans.
choice_data_list: The important thing to winning over their hearts is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Honing the unique individuality of each Umamusume.
Just like Haiseiko did!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"If everyone believes in themselves and shines,
so many people are sure to notice them☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding how to hone an Umamusume's individuality...
It seems I'll need to dig a little deeper into this.
